title: Freshness at lookup: revalidation on HTTP errors, soft 404s, unreachable hosts and a changed registry
goal: A page with no extractable text is no soft 404 and prints source-dated only, never not found; an HTTP error of the revalidation's search or a candidate page keeps the offline stamp and names the request; a provider host that failed to connect once is skipped with no request for the rest of the process and a bounded window; the provider-signals memo is keyed and refilled from the current registry, so a long-lived process writes no stale signals

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?

notes: Run order 7 of 19 from the 2026-10-12 draft triage: lookup correctness and benchmark measurement first, then kb content, then tooling that fixes recurring sprint failures.
